summary: Frontend-only iteration 4 testing: verified home screen entry, Alfred bubble/popup, chat overlay open/close via back button, party chips (solo/couple/group) inserted between destination and duration, hamburger menu with profile/saved/new-chat/history, calendar date-range picker, budget-isolation fix (₹25,000 preserved through Modify -> Hotel), contact autofill from traveller name (Nancy Lu -> nancy.lu@gmail.com), full booking success with booking-reference, and mobile/desktop responsiveness. All targeted fixes and new features work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: HomeScreen has a decorative `home-menu-button` and `home-nav-*` buttons that are not wired to any handler (no-op). Not blocking, but they look interactive.

In App.js handleSelectHotel/handleBudgetText read `booking` from closure (not functional setState) when composing the message text. This works because the budget was set via setBooking in the same handler chain, but relying on stale closure is fragile — consider computing the message inside the functional updater to avoid future budget-isolation regressions.

MenuDrawer's `menu-saved-list` opens the saved drawer only when the menu is opened from within the chat overlay (since SavedTripsDrawer/MenuDrawer are rendered inside the chat overlay block). This is by design but coupling is worth noting.
Itinerary summary 'Open' button opens the editor as expected but does not expose a `summary-open-editor` data-testid (uses different testid). Minor testability concern only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 acceptance criteria verified via Playwright at 390px and 1280px. Booking end-to-end path (chip-help-booking -> calendar -> budget 25000 -> hotel-select -> Modify -> Hotel -> hotel-select -> Sounds Okay -> Okay -> traveller Nancy Lu/26 -> contact autofill nancy.lu@gmail.com -> seat-chip-no -> booking-reference) all pass. Budget stayed ₹25,000 throughout (no ₹52,000 leak). Header back button closes overlay; menu-new-chat resets messages.
